name: Injuu Gakuen EX ~La Blue Girl~
source:
This novel is an adaptation of the [url=https://anidb.net/anime/682]Injuu Gakuen EX OVA[/url].

Young ninja Midou Miko's fortune predicts that she's about to fall in love when an unexpected downpour throws her into the arms of Hidemasa -whom she immediately recognizes as the man of her dreams!

Poor Miko must not only stave off the jealosy of her friend, Fubuki Kai, but is forced to put her fantasies on hold when she learns of the ancient and mysterious 'male' and 'female' flutes which are wreaking havoc on her parents and women on Earth. Suspecting that the new man in her life might know something about the flutes, she must enlist his aid, or perish!

[From [url=https://anidb.net/anime/682]AniDB[/url]]
translation:
这本小说改编自[url=https://anidb.net/anime/682]Injuu Gakuen EX OVA[/url]。

年轻忍者御堂巫子的命运预示着她即将坠入爱河，一场意外的倾盆大雨将她投入了秀政的怀抱，她立即认出秀政就是她的梦中情人！

可怜的巫女不仅必须摆脱她的朋友吹雪海的嫉妒，而且当她得知古老而神秘的“男性”和“女性”笛子正在给地球上的父母和女人造成严重破坏时，她被迫搁置自己的幻想。她怀疑她生命中的新男人可能对长笛有所了解，她必须寻求他的帮助，否则就会灭亡！

[来自[url=https://anidb.net/anime/682]AniDB[/url]]
